result.summary: The page is largely intact with no critical or major visual defects. A couple of minor polish items around placeholder content and icon rendering were noticed.

issues.description: The top-right circular profile/avatar button is empty except for a small red dot, with no user image, initials, or recognizable placeholder icon.
issues.suggestion: Add a default avatar icon or user initials inside the circle so the button clearly communicates its purpose.

issues.description: The inactive Search tab icon appears to have an unexpected dot inside the magnifying-glass lens, making it look like an icon artifact or inconsistent with the rest of the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Use a standard magnifying-glass icon without the inner dot, or verify the icon asset is rendering correctly.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text is very light grey on a light background, which can be hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to improve contrast and readability.
